name: captk-coregistration
label: CaPTk - Preprocessing co-registration
description: Registers a moving 3D NIfTI image to a fixed 3D NIfTI image with Greedy (rigid or affine, normalized mutual information, 100x50x5 iterations, image-centre initialization) and writes the moving image resliced onto the fixed image's grid, as CaPTk's Preprocessing -reg did. No bias correction is applied and deformable registration is not available. Greedy draws random sample jitter, so repeated runs differ by a fraction of a voxel.
author: PICSL (Greedy), CBICA (CaPTk)

moving_image.description: Moving image (nifti, a single 3D volume) to register to the fixed image.

fixed_image.description: Fixed image (nifti, a single 3D volume) to register the moving image to. The output is on this image's grid.

registration_type.description: The kind of registration: 'Rigid' (6 degrees of freedom), 'Affine' (12), or 'Affine-6', 'Affine-7' (rigid plus isotropic scaling) or 'Affine-12'; not case-sensitive. Any other value, including 'Deformable', is refused (defaults to Affine).

intermediate_files.description: Set to 1 to also save the transformation matrix as affine_<moving>TO<fixed>_NMI.mat (defaults to 0).

output_file_name.description: File name for the registered image; it must end in .nii.gz (defaults to output.nii.gz).
